# COPHIR

> COPHIR is a business development firm for the Oil & Gas sector in West Africa. It finds and qualifies real opportunities (tenders, RFQs, direct client needs) in Côte d'Ivoire and the wider region, and brings together the partners able to win them: local companies, international contractors, specialists and suppliers. UK company (registered office: 71–75 Shelton Street, London WC2H 9JQ), working across Côte d'Ivoire and West Africa. Founder: Jacques Coquerel. Contact: contact@cophir.com.

COPHIR (version française) : cabinet de développement commercial Oil & Gas en Afrique de l'Ouest. Il identifie les opportunités et réunit les partenaires locaux et internationaux capables de les remporter, notamment en Côte d'Ivoire.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.cophir.com/): what COPHIR does — opportunities, partners, how it works
- [For local companies](https://www.cophir.com/local-companies): technical partners, equipment, references and financing for local companies and project holders
- [For international contractors](https://www.cophir.com/international-contractors): qualified opportunities, local partner and local content setup in Côte d'Ivoire
- [About](https://www.cophir.com/about): mission, positioning, vision, founder and rules of engagement
- [Contact](https://www.cophir.com/contact): submit an opportunity or present your capabilities

## Sectors

- [Subsea](https://www.cophir.com/subsea): diving, ROV, inspection, IRM, underwater maintenance
- [Topside](https://www.cophir.com/topside): platform maintenance, integrity and NDT, mechanical and electrical works
- [Offshore & Marine](https://www.cophir.com/offshore-marine): vessels, marine services and logistics, offshore support
- [Downstream](https://www.cophir.com/downstream): oil storage tank maintenance, pipeline welding, terminals
- [Environmental](https://www.cophir.com/environmental): waste, sludge and effluent management, HSE services
- [Industrial procurement](https://www.cophir.com/industrial-procurement): specialised equipment for upstream and downstream projects
